testo:
■ Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your water, darkness or fire creatures. (If a card is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature.)
Powered Breaker
■ This creature gets +1000 power for each card in your graveyard.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, you may put the top 2 cards of your deck into your graveyard.
